criteria.requirement: Add figure_mode="legacy"|"group" to actual figure/figcaption/image processing. Group mode creates readable paragraph boundaries around the group, each image and each caption, preserving source order, original alt text, inline caption formatting, multiple/nested figures, caption-only/empty cases and neighboring body text. Existing ignore_images/images_to_alt/images-as-HTML behavior remains authoritative; never replace alt with caption or drop captions when images are disabled. Reset grouping depth at finish including unclosed EOF, retain default compatibility and reject unknown figure strategies.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
